app.name: SubZen
app.long_description:
### About tat.rocks  

tat.rocks is an independent studio that builds focused, practical tools for support teams.  

### What SubZen does  

SubZen analyzes your Zendesk ticket description and generates a concise, relevant subject line using AI — saving agents the time of writing one manually. It works directly from the ticket sidebar with a single click.  

**Supports:** English, Spanish, French, Italian, and Mandarin Chinese.  

**Key features:**  

* Detects ticket language automatically  
* Generates a subject in one click from the ticket sidebar  
* Optional auto-apply on ticket open  
* Bring your own API key (OpenAI or Groq) or use the shared SubZen service  

### Data Disclosure  

SubZen accesses the ticket description field for the sole purpose of generating a subject line suggestion. This text is sent over HTTPS to a proxy hosted on Supabase, which forwards it to an AI language model provider (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Groq, depending on your configuration). No ticket data is stored or logged by SubZen or its proxy service. Data is processed in transit only and discarded once the response is returned.  

By installing this app, users acknowledge that ticket description content will be transmitted to and processed by the selected AI provider in accordance with their respective privacy policies.
app.installation_instructions:
SubZen detects the ticket language automatically and generates a concise subject.

✓ autoApply — check this to apply the subject automatically when a ticket opens.

✓ fallback_en_es_fr_it_zh — language to use if the ticket language cannot be detected.
   en (English) · es (Spanish) · fr (French) · it (Italian) · zh (Mandarin)

forceLanguage.label: Always use fallback language (ignore ticket language detection)

ai_provider.label: AI Provider (optional)
ai_provider.helpText: Enter 'openai' or 'groq' to use your own API key instead of the shared service.

ai_api_key.label: Your AI API Key (optional)
ai_api_key.helpText: API key for your chosen AI provider. Leave blank to use the shared SubZen service.
